$scf¶

Spin restriction, convergence, iteration limits and SCF solver.

restrict¶

Type: switch
Default: none stated
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; 08 t48

Default: 1 for a closed-shell singlet, otherwise 0. Version 25 ran O2 with mult=3 (an even number of electrons) unrestricted without being told.

Spin restriction.

Value

Meaning

0

Spin-unrestricted.

1

Spin-restricted (available only for a few methods).

See also: mix ($guess)

convergence¶

Type: list
Default: 1e-6,1e-3
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; 01 §4.5 (output echo, energy gradient); 05 §5.1; 04 #322-#324; 08 t01, t07a, t07b; 08 t22a-c; 08 t74b (gradient vs threshold); 08 Slurm (erations); 08 review check (convergence value series)

Default: the first value is for SCF and the second for CP-SCF.

SCF and CP-SCF convergence thresholds. The SCF value is a threshold on the energy gradient: in version 25, an SCF whose gradient stayed near 2·10⁻⁶ ended with no convergence! at the default 1e-6. The defaults are recommended. To save time in difficult cases you may loosen the SCF value to 1e-5 for preliminary geometry optimizations.

Note

Put iterations= before convergence=, or give convergence two values. A one-value convergence= followed by iterations= stops the run with *** error in '$scf' : unknown name terations, also when the two keywords are on separate lines. The message names iterations with its first letters missing; how many depended on the machine, not on the value (terations on one computer, erations with p4_d on another, for every value tried). Other keywords after a one-value convergence=, such as restrict=, were read correctly. iterations=250 convergence=1e-7 and convergence=1e-7,1e-3 iterations=250 both work. Check the scf: conv = …; iter=… echo line in the output.

See also: iterations ($scf), procedure ($scf)

iterations¶

Type: list
Default: 32,16
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; 01 §4.5; 04 #319; 05 §5; Dft.rtf; 02 §3.2 (pri help); 04 #306; 08 t01, t10, t28, t71b

Default: Version 25 echoes iter=32,16 for DFT. v6, v13 and v15 echoed 16,16, a HF run for CCSD showed 48,16, and Dft.rtf gives 30 (older version). The default may depend on the method and version.

Maximum number of iterations and of microiterations (iterations=it,micro).

Note

An unconverged SCF does not stop the run. Version 25 prints no convergence!, then still prints E =, the orbitals and the properties, and exits with status 0. Search the output for no convergence!.

Raising the limit moderately is fine: an OH radical failed at the default 32 iterations and converged after 34 with iterations=100. A very large limit does not replace understanding why the SCF is not converging (Dft.rtf warns against it). A recommended technique for difficult cases is to cap the run at iterations=10, save the vectors ($control save=) and restart with $guess read=1, repeating as needed.

See also: convergence ($scf), read ($guess)

procedure¶

Type: enum
Default: nr
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; Dft.rtf; 04 #320; 08 t07b

Default: nr for GGA DFT.

Algorithm for solving the SCF equations. If one procedure fails, try the other.

Value

Meaning

nr

Newton–Raphson quadratically convergent. Can recover even from a wrong starting electronic configuration but may blow up in hard cases. (default)

bfgs

BFGS Hessian update. Less prone to blowing up but usually slower and sometimes converges poorly.

Example:

$scf convergence=1e-7 procedure=bfgs iterations=250 $end
$grid accuracy=1e-9 $end

d1small¶

Type: switch
Default: 0
Status: current · not verified
Sources: input.txt

Small-component density in quadratically convergent SCF.

Value

Meaning

1

Include the small-component density in the linear equations of quadratically convergent SCF (scalar-relativistic pure DFT).

0

Discard these contributions. This is faster, but SCF may fail to converge for molecules containing the heaviest atoms. (default)

See also: four ($control)

core¶

Type: integer
Default: none stated
Status: current · not verified
Sources: input.txt

Default: computed from the atom table; see $atoms core.

Number of core electrons for HF-based methods.

See also: core ($atoms)
